# ADR-3105: A09: Prefer centralized SIEM correlation for detection pack 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Siloed logs miss lateral movement.

## Decision

Security teams SHOULD prefer centralized SIEM correlation for detection pack 9 (A09-9) when stitching multi-system attacks.

## Consequences

Use cases are versioned as code.
